communities.name: lora-theory
communities.summary: 社区围绕内在维度理论，两篇论文分别从语言模型微调有效性与目标景观维度提供实证支撑，概念实体提炼ID假说，阐明LoRA低秩约束的有效性并指导秩选择。

communities.name: lora-variants
communities.summary: 社区围绕LoRA低秩适配展开：LoRA为基础概念，QLoRA、AdaLoRA、Bayesian-LoRA、HiLoRA分别从量化、秩分配、概率推断与联邦分层角度扩展其职责，各论文实体对应阐述相应变体方法。

communities.name: loralib-core
communities.summary: loralib-core 社区包含 LoRALayer 基类及 Embedding、Linear、MergedLinear、ConvLoRA 等子类，各子类实现初始化、重置参数、训练与前向方法；utils.py 提供可训练标记与状态字典函数，setup.py 负责打包。

communities.name: nlg-examples
communities.summary: 该社区围绕NLG示例构建，data_utils提供语料与迭代器，encoder负责BPE编解码，model定义GPT2结构，optimizer管理优化与调度，gpt2_ft/beam/decode支撑训练与生成，gpu与exp_utils提供分布式及实验辅助。

properties.description: Fine-tuning large pre-trained language models on downstream tasks has become an important paradigm in NLP. However, common practice fine-tunes all of the parameters in a pre-trained model, which becomes prohibitive when a large number of downstream tasks are present. Therefore, many fine-tuning methods are proposed to learn incremental updates of pre-trained weights in a parameter efficient way, e.g., low-rank increments. properties.description: Large language models are typically optimized for accuracy and, therefore, will guess even when uncertain about their predictions. This prob- lem becomes especially pronounced when the model is fine-tuned on small datasets, which of- ten causes overfitting and results in a tendency toward miscalibration. nodes.name: QLoRA Efficient Finetuning of Quantized LLMs

properties.description: We present QL ORA, an efficient finetuning approach that reduces memory us- age enough to finetune a 65B parameter model on a single 48GB GPU while preserving full 16-bit finetuning task performance. QL ORA backpropagates gradi- ents through a frozen, 4-bit quantized pretrained language model into Low Rank Adapters (LoRA).
